source_epm: Dunks & Threes EPM feed (https://dunksandthrees.com/epm/__data.json), 'Expected impact and stats for Thursday, October 22, 2026 using preceding career data', 520 players; league means from all 30 teams (off -0.067, def 3.348)
method: Team rating = sum(EPM_off/def x minutes/48) over top 240 projected minutes, centered on the 30-team mean. Same method as 10/21. Only the four teams playing 10/22 are included.
source_injuries: Official NBA Injury Report 10/22/26 11:30 AM ET (https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-10-22_11_30AM.pdf), read from the PDF screenshot; a later report (1:30 PM) may change statuses
injury_rule: Only players inside the healthy top-240 rotation carry a cost; P(play): questionable 0.50, out 0 (nba_sim priors, ESTIMATES)
